verdict.rationale: Baseten is presented throughout as a managed cloud platform (Model APIs, dedicated GPU deployments, training jobs, MCM orchestration) with no documentation of an on-premises or self-hosted deployment mode for the core platform. Truss (baseten-gh-1..7) is only an open-source model-packaging/serving library used to push models to Baseten's cloud, not a way to self-host Baseten itself.
